source.quote: IFF delivered strong second-quarter results with 6% sales growth across all businesses, driven by volume growth and productivity improvements
IFF reported robust free cash flow generation of $378 million in the first half of 2026, a $284 million improvement year-over-year
Management announced a $2.5B share repurchase program
IFF's quarterly dividend per share was $0.40 as of January 9, 2026
IFF lifted its full-year 2026 guidance for continuing operations to sales of $7.4 billion-$7.6 billion (+2%-4%) and EBITDA of $1.53 billion-$1.60 billion (+4%-8%)
